record.title: Validate the first three stock calibration loaders as one bounded sequence
record.intent: Test static whole-loader predictions using the verified readable filesystem fixture and unchanged native observer.
requirements: Pin static loader recovery private observer controls complete application-domain file reads and the unchanged loader-capable native binary; preserve stock APK native library assets and original guest ramdisk bytes.

Prepare the same derived-ramdisk tmpfs with two exact default files and their tested existing application-data type; retain modes owners directory types and four absent paths; verify preconditions before stock launch.

Freeze a stock-loader harness and independent verifier before one fresh run; validate complete inherited two-DNA-read 466-store ten-tail-read prefix and stock loader bindings addresses instructions return statuses and whole capture hashes from raw evidence.

Run unchanged stock native code through LSB vertical and ADC loaders with no new modeled MMIO responses; predict returns 192 and 1794240 and minus1, capture entry and terminal ADC bytes, and stop before SetADCParameter zero without executing its instruction.

Require terminal thread convergence and complete raw captures for both stock payloads and unchanged ADC bytes; report actual entry state separately from static zero-fill inference and stop on unexpected accesses clones statuses signals or deadlines without adaptive rerun.

Test verifier acceptance and meaningful altered-evidence rejection with regenerated indexes; capture final system_server enforcement process package file bytes labels absent paths and cleanup even on failure; discard the disposable guest and commit and push the precise conclusion before another experiment.
acceptance: Commit and push a supported whole-loader observation or an exact reproducible divergence.
